title: Methi Thepla
description: Soft Gujarati flatbreads flavoured with fresh fenugreek, besan and sesame that keep well for travel and lunchboxes.
steps: Mix the atta, besan, chilli powder, turmeric, cumin, sesame, salt and fenugreek leaves in a bowl.
Rub in 1 tbsp of the oil with your fingertips.
Add the water a little at a time and knead into a firm, smooth dough; rest for 10 minutes.
Divide into 12 balls and roll each into a thin round, dusting with a little flour.
Cook each thepla on a hot tawa until brown spots appear, flip and drizzle a few drops of the remaining oil.
Press gently and cook until crisp-edged and cooked through, then stack in a cloth.
